about: The falsifier: at 315 a signed batch carried no place, and the cycle's accept applied its --place flags to every batch's own lines. A lane covering several places, like lane C over verify, obligations and topos-doc, would land a line meant for one of them in every named place its key covers. And rebirth.sh had no verb to name a release by bound's digest, so it would import fold/laid.ts directly.

cases.name: a verify-only line in a cycle that also names obligations and topos-doc, at 315
